Name: Pride Anpan
Author: EchosBento
Description:
For Pride this year I wanted to do something simple, we have a bunch of fun pride themed mods and I honestly didn't want to add to that just for there to be yet another mod that some LGBT person will look into and go "But this doesn't have [i]my[/i] flag." So instead, being an LGBT person myself, I figured the best option was to just make something for me. Anpan has long been one of my favorite foods, so now you can make it in game!

Pride Anpan adds a custom Adzuki Bean crop, craftable Anko Paste, and craftable Anpan. Adzuki Bean Starts can be purchased from Pierre, while both recipes can be purchased from Gus.

Disclaimer that this mod may conflict with PPJA Fruits and Veggies as that mod also adds an Adzuki Bean crop.
